name: Main team
blurb: The main team learns suspended bridge design, designs the bridge, and writes the technical reports for each review call with Engineers in Action's engineers.
commitment: Meets with the whole chapter on Wednesdays at 5:30 PM in CMU 230

name: Logistics team
blurb: The logistics team raises the money that gets each bridge built and runs the chapter's operations. You don't need any engineering background to join it, and members work in smaller groups.
commitment: Meets on Mondays at 5:30 PM in MEB 237
groups: Corporate sponsorships, which reaches out to companies and follows up with contacts from career fairs
Grants, where each member writes and submits grant applications
Events, which runs on-campus fundraisers such as bake sales and pizza sales
Product development, which designs and makes the souvenirs we sell during cherry blossom season
Love, The Ave, our sponsorship program with local businesses
Social media and marketing, which makes our posts, videos, and LinkedIn presence
